Fourseason variants multiply RGB palette channels with alpha preserved, autumn and winter layered from generated transparent leaf/snow art. limitations: Regeneration prompts capture provenance and are reusable. Pixel-identical generative model output is not guaranteed; deterministic export from provided original source sheets is reproducible. Action states use 4 distinct poses and a reusable SE-facing view; walking has four diagonal directions. Every profession role has its own distinct illustrated idle/work/collect/unload sheet, with meaningful hammering, hunting preparation, axe chopping, food processing or farming activity.
